basic_details.job_title: ICSI Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) has invited applications from its Company Secretary members for 5 Young Professional posts on contract in the Central Facility Centres (CRC/C-PACE/CSC/CPC) of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India, at Manesar, Haryana. The consolidated pay is Rs. 75,000 per month in the first year, for a maximum of three years. Candidates must apply online; the link is active from 6 November 2026 to 20 November 2026 and the maximum age is 32 years as on 1 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Apply only through the online electronic application form, using the application link given in the notice.
Use Windows Explorer (6.x to 11.x only) or Google Chrome with JavaScript enabled. The notice says not to use Mozilla Firefox, Netscape Navigator or any other browser.
Fill the online resume form carefully and completely. Incomplete or vague applications, or those not in the prescribed format, will be rejected.
Do not enter special characters such as quotation marks, apostrophes or &, and keep entries for university name, specialisation, major responsibilities, address and board and school name short.
Round percentages down to the lower whole number (49.3% or 49.8% is entered as 49%). Convert grades to numerical equivalent percentages.
Upload a resume file not exceeding 100 KB.

The notice asks candidates to keep a printout of the online form and not to send the hard copy of the form, CVs or certificates to the Institute. No separate acknowledgement is sent. For queries, write to the Directorate of HR, The Institute of Company Secretaries of India, at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: ICSI Young Professional at a Glance

rows.details: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India

content_sections.heading: About ICSI
content_sections.text: The Institute of Company Secretaries of India is the body whose members, qualified Company Secretaries, are invited under this notice. The Young Professionals will work in the Central Facility Centres of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India, at Manesar, Haryana. The notice says these Central Facilities exist to deliver the services rendered by the ROC (Registrar of Companies).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only qualified Company Secretaries who hold membership of the Institute can apply. Experience: post qualification experience of up to one year be considered. Training experience forming part of the CS course curriculum is not counted towards the total experience. Age: maximum 32 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. Cut-off date for all purposes, including age, qualifications and experience: 01.11.2026. Candidates must have good moral character, with no criminal antecedents or FIR against them. The notice states that the candidates should satisfy themselves about eligibility before applying; the official notification has the full conditions.

rows.qualification_required: Member of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A Young Professional is paid an additional Rs. 2500 per day for attending office on Sundays and holidays, depending on the exigencies of work to be decided by the respective ROC. The contract is for a maximum of three years, subject to satisfactory performance reviewed at the end of each year. The tenure is initially one year. It may be extended every year up to a maximum of two more years based on performance and requirement, or until the age of 35 years, whichever is earlier. The appointment is full-time, and Young Professionals may not take up any other assignment during the contract. The notice does not mention TA/DA for the selection process or for joining; it states that none is admissible.

content_sections.heading: ICSI Young Professional Job Description
content_sections.text: Examine and process e-forms under the Companies Act 2013 and the LLP Act 2008, read with the relevant rules, as per the roles assigned in the CRC, C-PACE, CSC and CPC offices where they are deployed. Dispose of the minimum number of forms or targets set by the Central Facility Centres, within limits or targets prescribed by the respective ROCs. Productivity beyond the benchmark carries significant weightage in performance appraisals and reviews.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICSI Young Professional
content_sections.text: Apply only through the online electronic application form, using the application link given in the notice. Submit the form between 06.11.2026 and 20.11.2026. Use Windows Explorer (6.x to 11.x only) or Google Chrome with JavaScript enabled. The notice says not to use Mozilla Firefox, Netscape Navigator or any other browser. Fill the online resume form carefully and completely. Incomplete or vague applications, or those not in the prescribed format, will be rejected. Do not enter special characters such as quotation marks, apostrophes or &, and keep entries for university name, specialisation, major responsibilities, address and board and school name short. Round percentages down to the lower whole number (49.3% or 49.8% is entered as 49%). Convert grades to numerical equivalent percentages. Upload a resume file not exceeding 100 KB. The notice asks candidates to keep a printout of the online form and not to send the hard copy of the form, CVs or certificates to the Institute. No separate acknowledgement is sent. For queries, write to the Directorate of HR, The Institute of Company Secretaries of India, at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are screened by the Selection Committee, and shortlisted candidates are informed about the final selection process. ICSI may communicate with applicants by e-mail and not by post, so candidates should have a valid personal e-mail address and check it regularly. Original documents are required for verification at a subsequent stage. Selected candidates undergo an orientation programme on the functions of the Central Facility Centres. The notice does not describe any written test or interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many Young Professional posts has ICSI announced?
faq.answer: ICSI has announced 5 Young Professional posts on contractual basis in the Central Facility Centres at Manesar, Haryana.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ICSI Young Professional?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 20 November 2026. The online link is active from 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ICSI Young Professional?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a member of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India, that is, a qualified Company Secretary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICSI Young Professional?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years as on 1 November 2026. The notice prints no minimum age and no relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay of an ICSI Young Professional?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 75,000 per month in the first year, Rs. 80,000 in the second year and Rs. 85,000 in the third year. Rs. 2500 per day is paid additionally for attending office on Sundays and holidays.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ICSI Young Professional?
faq.answer: Apply only through the online application form between 6 and 20 November 2026, using Windows Explorer or Google Chrome. Upload a resume file of not more than 100 KB and do not send hard copies to the Institute.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for ICSI Young Professional?
faq.answer: Applications are screened by the Selection Committee, and shortlisted candidates are informed about the final selection process by e-mail. Original documents are verified at a subsequent stage.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ICSI Young Professional job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual post. The tenure is initially one year, extendable every year up to two more years, for a maximum of three years, or until age 35, whichever is earlier. Engaged persons have no right to claim employment in the Government of India or ICSI.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA given for the ICSI selection process?
faq.answer: No TA/DA is admissible for appearing for the selection process, for joining the assignment or on its completion.

faq.question: Q10. What experience is needed for ICSI Young Professional?
faq.answer: Post qualification experience of up to one year be considered. Training experience forming part of the CS course curriculum is not counted.
